envelope.description: Prove the MCP server holds no store and runs survive its restart

body.title: Prove the MCP server holds no store and runs survive its restart
body.summary: Integration tests over a real MCP server process (stdio) against a daemon in a temporary home: after one call of each moved tool lsof shows no store file or lance directory in the MCP process; a multi-turn analyze step and workflow step continue through a new MCP process with the same state token; prompts, schemas and state tokens are byte-identical to the in-process replies.
acceptanceChecks: lsof of the MCP process shows no graph.lmdb, graph.lmdb-lock or lance path after each tool
a run continues across an MCP process restart
the emit_plan / emit_step replies are byte-identical

tests.name: no store in the MCP process: lsof of a real MCP server process shows no store file or lance path after each tool
ac2 restart: an analyze step and a workflow step continue through a new MCP process with the same state token
ac5 pass-through: emit_plan and emit_step prompts, schemas and state are byte-identical to the in-process replies
ac3: with no daemon every moved tool returns DaemonUnreachableError through a real MCP process, which opens no store; against a daemon without step.call, DaemonTooOldError
